notes.title: Arttista Version 2.0.4 Update & Game Character Creation Tutorial
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that [b]Arttista has received a major update to Version 2.0.4[/b]! This new version brings a powerful new feature: [b]Object Scaling[/b]! You can now scale objects horizontally, vertically, or both, [b]without affecting the object’s outline[/b]. This gives you more control and flexibility in your designs.

Along with this update, we’ve also released a new tutorial series on our Arttista YouTube channel, dedicated to [b]Game Character Creation[/b]. The series consists of 3 comprehensive tutorials:

[list]
[*]1/3: Drawing a Game Character – Learn how to create and design this character.
[previewyoutube=cRZbqOJhavE;full][/previewyoutube]

[*]2/3: Animating Your Character – Bring this character to life with animation techniques.
[previewyoutube=gVAe-A1hgCA;full][/previewyoutube]

[*]3/3: Exporting to Sprite Sheet – Discover how to export your animated character into a sprite sheet for game development.
[previewyoutube=_jqdbR3OW8k;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
Check out the full series on our YouTube channel, and take your game character creation skills to the next level with Arttista!

notes.title: Full Version of This Spine-chilling Short Film Made On Arttista!
notes.notes:
🎃 The moment has arrived! 🎃

[previewyoutube=Icm8AJWoW68;full][/previewyoutube]
With great pride and excitement, I present to you "Trick or Treats – A Halloween Tale", the full version of this spine-chilling short film that first haunted (and captivated!) audiences with its initial release on Halloween 2023. Now, the story reaches its dark conclusion, filled with surprises and terrifying moments that will stir your emotions.

This short film was entirely created using Arttista and every detail in the production helped to test and refine the amazing features that make Arttista a unique tool for unleashing creativity. From its ghostly strokes to the hair-raising animations, everything was crafted to deliver a unique and immersive visual experience.

The official release is happening today, October 21st, on the Arttista YouTube channel! Get ready to dive into a world of mystery, magic, and suspense. Remember: not everything is as it seems... and some things are even scarier than your imagination can predict.

So, turn off the lights, crank up the volume, and come experience this Halloween with me! 🎃👻

The video will premiere today at 9 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST).

And don’t forget... unleash the "Arttista" within you!

Happy Halloween! And beware... be very aware... 😈

notes.title: 1.1.10 Version Just Has Arrived.
notes.notes:
Yeah yeah yeah! Caffeine don't let me stop. 

Here it is, Arttista 1.1.10 version with useful bug corrections.

1) "predefined shapes" mouse cursor was entire white, what can let anyone crazy when your background is also white. Now, mouse cursor has a foreground color.

2) "predefined shapes" shortcut was wrong. Correctly shortcut is CTRL+9

3) when you use free hand brush, after mouse release, the auto-simplify is called. But, if you are painting inside some shape(or object), this shape, after auto-simplify, was deselected. Now, it remains selected.

This is it.

Have a nice Arttista day.

Helmuth
